method: Each definition in s18-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its named test run alone (vitest -t), every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the test rerun. Integration tests run on local PostgreSQL with the real schema built from the migrations, as envoi_web, envoi_maintenance or the superuser where the test says; merchant accounts and their FIXTURE shops are created as in S8, and PayPal is the labeled FIXTURE fake. The migration mutation edits drizzle/0024_order_archive.sql, which each test database applies afresh. A proof also needs the mutated run to fail on an AssertionError.

results.mutation: Drop the already-archived early return; the update is limited to unarchived rows, so the trigger never fires and only the guard's absence shows: a repeat writes a second audit row.
results.error: AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality

results.test: another outlet's order cannot be archived
results.mutation: Drop the membership condition from the archive read, so any merchant can archive any outlet's order.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 200 to be 404 // Object.is equality

results.test: an agent token or buyer session cannot archive
results.mutation: Skip the merchant-account guard in the archive route and pass a stand-in user id for a principal that is not a merchant account.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 404 to be 403 // Object.is equality

results.test: an agent token or buyer session cannot archive
results.mutation: Drop the same-origin check from the archive route.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 200 to be 403 // Object.is equality

results.test: an order archived before it was paid comes back as Paid
results.mutation: List only orders that were never archived, so an order paid after its archive stays hidden.
results.error: AssertionError: expected undefined to match object { state: 'paid' }

results.test: a paid order archived stays hidden
results.mutation: List every archived order that is paid now, including one already paid when it was archived.

results.test: the web role cannot clear an archive
results.mutation: Leave out the trigger in migration 0024, so the web role's column grant can clear an archive.
results.error: AssertionError: promise resolved "[]" instead of rejecting

results.test: export writes one receipt per archived order without buyer identity
results.mutation: Add the buyer's user id to each exported receipt.
